checks: held gesture previews enter/leave a supported workstation and remain separate from real activity
real work preempts rapid previews; cancellation and late callbacks cannot revive old gestures
hidden tabs stop callbacks and resume without elapsed-time jumps
offscreen or inactive views pause; returning restarts only one loop
reduced motion ends after a short pose transition; disabled mode never starts a continuous loop
limitations: No actual browser visual validation, layout, refresh-rate or native intersection observer verification.
